title: Add multi-handler admin panel with create and delete to Go web app
description: Extend the Go web app with a full admin panel: an HTML admin page showing item stats, a form-based create endpoint, and a POST-based delete endpoint.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend the go_web_app with an admin panel. Add the following to internal/handler/: 1. Create admin.go with three handlers: AdminPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) - Only handles GET. Responds 200 with HTML. - Renders templates/admin.html with a struct containing Items []Item, Count int, Total float64, Avg float64. - Count = len(Store), Total = sum of all prices, Avg = Total/Count (0 if Count==0). CreateAdminItem(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) - Only handles POST. Parses form fields: name (string) and price (float64). - Appends a new Item to Store with the next available ID (max existing ID + 1). - Responds 302 redirect to /admin. DeleteAdminItem(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) - Only handles POST. Extracts the item ID from the URL path (last segment). - Removes the matching item from Store. - Responds 302 redirect to /admin. 2. Create templates/admin.html with: - An

Admin Panel

heading. - A summary section showing 'Items: N' and 'Total: $X.XX'. - A listing all items (ID, Name, Price, Delete button). - Each Delete button is a with a submit button. - A with name and price text inputs and a Create button. 3. Create internal/handler/admin_test.go with 4 tests: - TestAdminPageOK: GET /admin returns 200 and HTML containing 'Admin Panel' - TestAdminPageShowsItems: GET /admin HTML contains 'Widget A' - TestCreateAdminItem: POST /admin/items with name=NewThing&price=5.00 returns 302; subsequent GET /admin contains 'NewThing' - TestDeleteAdminItem: POST /admin/items/1/delete returns 302; subsequent GET /admin does not contain 'Widget A' In each test, build a fresh *http.ServeMux, register AdminPage at 'GET /admin', CreateAdminItem at 'POST /admin/items', and DeleteAdminItem at 'POST /admin/items/{id}/delete'. Call ResetStore() before each test. Run go test ./... and go build ./... to confirm.
required_artifacts: templates/admin.html with heading, stats, items table, create form, delete forms
AdminPage renders item list and aggregate stats
CreateAdminItem appends to Store and redirects
DeleteAdminItem removes from Store and redirects
success_criteria: Admin page shows count and total price
Create and delete handlers modify Store correctly
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
